title: Simple Dishcloth
description: A practical square project for learning rows and building even tension.
expectationText: A steady row-by-row project for practicing even tension, clean edges, and the rhythm of turning your work.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Single crochet into the second chain from the hook and each chain across.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 18
steps.instruction: Chain 1, turn, and single crochet in each stitch across.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave in both ends.
